faq.q: How is AI-augmented delivery different from just using ChatGPT?
faq.a: We've built custom AI pipelines integrated into our development workflow — automated testing, intelligent code review, content generation, and project management. It's not about pasting code from ChatGPT. It's about systematically using AI at every stage to deliver faster without cutting corners.

Every person who touches your project has 8+ years of professional experience. No graduates learning on your budget. No offshore handoffs at midnight. The person in your kickoff meeting is the person writing your code.

faq.q: How long does a typical project take?
faq.a: A marketing site: 4-8 weeks. A complex web application: 8-16 weeks. An AI integration: 2-6 weeks. We'll give you a realistic timeline in our discovery call — and we stick to it.

faq.q: Do you work with our existing platform?
faq.a: Yes. We specialise in Drupal and WordPress but work across the web stack. We can extend, migrate, or rebuild — whatever makes sense. We'll always recommend the right platform, even if it's not one we specialise in.
We offer ongoing retainer support for maintenance, updates, and continuous improvement. Or we do a clean handover with full documentation. Your choice — no lock-in.

faq.q: Can you help us figure out what we need?
faq.a: Absolutely. That's what the free discovery call is for. And if you need deeper exploration, our strategy consulting or AI hackday formats are designed to answer exactly that question.

A senior developer costs £80-120K/year plus benefits, management overhead, and ramp-up time. With us, you get senior talent immediately, scale up or down as needed, and pay only for what you use. Plus you get a team, not a single point of failure.
